routing.title: Routing
routing.empty_desc: Add an API key or OAuth credential under AI Providers or Auth Files first.
routing.model_placeholder: All models (type a model to preview its route)
routing.tier_state_standby: Standby, used when every tier above is unavailable
routing.tier_state_skipped_model: Does not offer this model; requests skip this tier
routing.tier_state_skipped: No available members; requests skip this tier
routing.tier_state_cooling: Cooling down or unavailable; requests skip this tier
routing.tier_state_unknown: Some members' models are unknown; this tier may serve
routing.connector: Falls to the next tier when the whole tier is unavailable
routing.drop_new_tier: Drop here to make a new tier
routing.exhausted_retry: Returns an error after {{count}} more retry rounds
routing.footnote: The preview ignores session affinity, live API-key cooldowns and WebSocket preference. API-key models are inferred from configuration; plugin-registered models show as unknown.
routing.locked_priority_conflict: Cannot place a tier here: locked credentials leave no available priority. Join an existing tier instead.
routing.locked: Runtime-only credential: no file to store a priority, so it cannot move
routing.drag_handle: Drag {{name}}, or use the up and down arrow keys to change its tier
routing.weight_hint: Only used by weighted round-robin. Empty counts as 1; 0 takes no share.
routing.weight_inactive: The current strategy is not weighted round-robin, so weights have no effect yet.
routing.strategy_round_robin_desc: Each credential in the tier takes requests in turn.
routing.strategy_weighted_round_robin_desc: Requests are split across the tier by weight.
routing.strategy_fill_first_desc: One credential takes everything until it is unavailable, then the next.
routing.affinity_desc: Requests of one session stick to one credential, failing over when it becomes unavailable.
routing.request_retry_desc: Extra rounds after every credential fails in the first round.
routing.max_retry_credentials_desc: Most credentials tried per round; 0 tries all.
routing.review_hint: OAuth credentials are written one by one; everything else goes to the configuration in one write.
routing.save_partial: Save stopped: writing {{name}} failed ({{message}}). Applied: {{applied}}; not attempted: {{skipped}}.
routing.unsaved_message: Leaving this page loses the unsaved arrangement.
